baseline.conditions: East public gate joins an exterior approach at regional (1.5,0); the Burrow interior graph is unchanged.

title: Leaving is a civic act
daily_life: Garden loads, repaired tools and travelers share the road to Latchford. A goodbye at the public entrance can be warm without treating the whole town as an expedition camp.
timing: Departure uses the established east gate and regional approach (1.5,0). The itinerary begins outside the existing interior graph; do not draw a new gate.
handoff: An arrival house checks the actual passengers against the sender’s list. The returning goods list and the person count are separate records.
story_option: A missing name on a message may be a late passenger, a copy error or deliberate omission. A delayed arrival is a question before it is an accusation.
production: Open with a shared breakfast, show the exterior transition in a later episode, then cut to a changed sun angle and an overnight halt. Episode one contains none of this.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
